title: Gift capital parent ledger (template)
how_to_use: Copy this file to gifts.json (do not commit real donor names if the repo is public).
When a SEPA credit arrives, add a row with the bank fields.
Copy the Verwendungszweck into preference_code and decode it on ledger.html or with js/reference.js.
Fill sleeve percentages from the decoded code. The four percentages must sum to 100.
